title: Blue circle morphs into red square
description: 5-second -ql animation: a blue solid circle smoothly morphs into a red solid square, center stays put, title text 'Shape morph' pinned at top. Sanity demo of the manim project layout.

renders.command: uv run manim -ql --media_dir renders/debug/_build src/shape_morph.py ShapeMorph
uv run manim -qh --media_dir renders/final/_build src/shape_morph.py ShapeMorph

reproduce.debug: uv run manim -ql --media_dir renders/debug/_build src/shape_morph.py ShapeMorph
reproduce.final: uv run manim -qh --media_dir renders/final/_build src/shape_morph.py ShapeMorph

notes: First project under the renders/ layout convention. Source copied from green-baseline/scenes/scenario_1.py (skill-applied baseline).
